title: SUNDAY MOBILITY
subtitle: SUNDAY. GLUTE BRIDGES, SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE, CAT-COW, HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH WITH REACH, FIGURE-FOUR, WALL CHEST OPENER. STRETCH-HEAVY, STILL BARKED. ONE BALANCE, ONE STRENGTH, THEN OPEN EVERYTHING.

script.welcome: SUNDAY, GRIMES. THE CLOCKS FELL BACK, SO YOU GOT A FREE HOUR OF KIP. THAT MEANS NO EXCUSES. MOBILITY DAY, SEVENTEEN MINUTES. SLOW AND LOOSE, BUT YOU STILL ANSWER TO ME. ON THE FLOOR.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. MAKE IT YOUR BEST. EYES ON YOU.
script.complete: DISMISSED. HALLOWEEN'S OVER, GRIMES. ANY SWEETS LEFT IN THAT BOWL GO TO THE OFFICE OR THE BIN, NOT INTO YOU. PROTEIN AT LUNCH, BOTH WALKS TODAY. TOMORROW MORNING WE WEIGH, AND I WANT TWO THIRTY ONE. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGES
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT, FEET FLAT HIP-WIDTH. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES AND LIFT THE HIPS UNTIL SHOULDERS, HIPS AND KNEES LINE UP. PAUSE ONE SECOND AT THE TOP. LOWER SLOW. NO ARCHING THE LOWER BACK.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. THREE ROUNDS OF TWELVE. ON YOUR BACK, FEET FLAT, SQUEEZE AND LIFT. PAUSE AT THE TOP. LOWER SLOW. THAT BACKSIDE HAS BEEN SAT ON ALL WEEK, GRIMES. WAKE IT UP.
exercises.speakDone: BRIDGES DONE. BACKSIDE ON DUTY. GOOD.

exercises.name: SINGLE-LEG HINGE BALANCE
exercises.cue: STAND ON ONE LEG, KNEE SOFT, FINGERTIPS ON A WALL OR CHAIR IF NEEDED. HINGE FORWARD AT THE HIPS AS THE FREE LEG REACHES BACK, FLAT BACK, HIPS SQUARE. GO ONLY AS FAR AS YOU CONTROL. STAND TALL SLOWLY. 5 EACH LEG.
exercises.speakStart: SINGLE LEG HINGE. BALANCE. TWO ROUNDS, FIVE EACH LEG. STAND ON ONE LEG, TIP FORWARD FROM THE HIPS, BACK LEG REACHES BEHIND. FLAT BACK. FINGERTIPS ON THE WALL IF YOU WOBBLE. WOBBLING IS LEGAL. FALLING OVER IS PAPERWORK.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: ON ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. INHALE: DROP THE BELLY, LIFT CHEST AND TAILBONE (COW). EXHALE: ROUND THE BACK UP, TUCK CHIN AND TAILBONE (CAT). SLOW, ONE BREATH EACH WAY.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS OF EIGHT. ON ALL FOURS. BREATHE IN, BELLY DOWN, CHEST UP. BREATHE OUT, ROUND THE BACK LIKE AN ANGRY CAT. SLOW. ONE BREATH EACH WAY. YOUR FAVOURITE, GRIMES. ENJOY IT QUIETLY.

exercises.name: HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH WITH REACH
exercises.cue: HALF-KNEEL, BACK KNEE ON A CUSHION, FRONT FOOT FLAT. TUCK THE TAILBONE, SQUEEZE THE BACK GLUTE, SHIFT HIPS FORWARD GENTLY. REACH THE SAME-SIDE ARM AS THE BACK KNEE UP AND SLIGHTLY OVER. CHAIR NEARBY FOR BALANCE. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: HIP FLEXOR STRETCH. TWO ROUNDS, THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. HALF KNEEL, CUSHION UNDER THE KNEE. TUCK THE TAIL, SQUEEZE THE BACK CHEEK, HIPS FORWARD, ARM UP AND OVER. A DESK CHAIR TIES THESE IN KNOTS. UNTIE THEM.

exercises.name: FIGURE-FOUR STRETCH
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT. CROSS ONE ANKLE OVER THE OPPOSITE KNEE. THREAD HANDS BEHIND THE BOTTOM THIGH AND DRAW IT GENTLY TOWARD YOU UNTIL YOU FEEL THE OUTER HIP. HEAD DOWN, SHOULDERS RELAXED. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR. TWO ROUNDS, THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ON YOUR BACK, ANKLE OVER THE KNEE, PULL THE THIGH IN GENTLY. FEEL IT IN THE OUTER HIP. HEAD DOWN. DON'T FALL ASLEEP. I KNOW YOU'VE GOT AN EXTRA HOUR, BUT IT'S MINE.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: FOREARM ON THE WALL AT SHOULDER HEIGHT, ELBOW BENT 90 DEGREES. STEP THROUGH WITH THE NEAR FOOT AND TURN THE CHEST GENTLY AWAY UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER AND CHEST OPEN. SHOULDER DOWN, NO PAIN. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS, THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL, STEP THROUGH, TURN THE CHEST AWAY. GENTLE. STAND UP STRAIGHT FOR THE NEW WEEK, GRIMES. NO HUNCHBACKS IN MY SECTION.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN, SHOULDERS BACK. THAT IS SUNDAY DONE. DISMISSED.
